rules.name: draws a box from the press to the pointer
rules.note: The drawn box is not in any fixture: a server render never shows it, so its markup is not machine-checked. From the source: div.marquee-selection-box.place-rect.region-box.z-raised (plus region-box-accent when accent) holding four span.marquee-selection-handle with -north/-south and -west/-east, and p.marquee-selection-label.mono.text-xs.surface-raised.rounded-control.px-2.py-1 when a label is given. The press is forwarded by the app from its surface (the within element) through the exported pointerdown(); it draws only for a primary press with button 0 on the content (not a scrollbar), from an allowed pointer type, while not suppressed. A press from another pointer type is only watched, for a click.

rules.name: removes the box and reports the end when the pointer lifts

emits.with: click, too-small or selection, with the stroke

rules.note: A box narrower and shorter than the slop is a click (and onclick follows); one narrower or shorter than the minimum is too-small; anything larger is a selection. A lift by another pointer than the one held reports onrefuse with pointer-mismatch.
